package.description: The world's fastest HRRR weather map renderer - Rust CLI tool

en-US.description: The world's fastest HRRR weather map renderer - Rust CLI tool
en-US.longDescription: The world's fastest HRRR (High Resolution Rapid Refresh) map renderer, written in pure Rust. Downloads HRRR GRIB2 data from NOAA's AWS S3 bucket using byte-range requests, parses GRIB2 format, and renders beautiful weather maps as PNG using rayon parallelism.
en-US.name: HRRR-Render
